snippet.title: F1 25 First Look at Gameplay
snippet.description:
Get your first look at F1 25 gameplay with 15 minutes of exclusive footage across multiple tracks, hosted by Matt Gallagher and Alex Jacques. F1 25 is out May 30. Play 3 days early from May 27 with the Iconic Edition http://x.ea.com/84030

00:00 - F1 25 Official Gameplay Reveal
00:19 - Team & Driver Selection
00:27 - Austria - Reverse Track
02:17 - Miami - LIDAR Track
03:56 - Driver Radio - Oscar Piastri
04:10 - Podium Sequence
04:42 - Silverstone - Reverse Track
05:31 - Silverstone - Reverse Pitstop
07:00 - Bahrain - LIDAR Track
08:55 - Suzuka - LIDAR Track
10:52 - Melbourne - LIDAR Track (Wet)
12:47 - Zandvoort - Reverse Track
14:11 - Driver Radio - George Russell

Get more news 👉 https://linktr.ee/easportsf1
